results.title: The key contract is written and versioned before the first extract
results.expected: The contract read precedes the first proposal in the trace. The published type is accepted as proposed. The invented type is refused and the refusal is recorded. A build that never reads the contract fails.

stimulus.description: A build that reads the contract, then proposes one node of a published type and one of a type the contract does not name.

results.title: Every source is registered as an instrument, not a file path
results.expected: The complete one is registered as proposed. The bare one is refused with the missing fields named. A source accepted without a checksum fails.

stimulus.description: Two sources registered: one with every field, one with a title and a link only.

results.title: No node is live without a named acceptance and a replayable locator
results.expected: Exactly one node is live: the one with a name and a locator. The nameless acceptance and the locator-less node are refused, and both refusals are recorded. A live node with empty provenance fails.

stimulus.description: A source accepted by a person, nodes proposed from it, one accepted with a name, one accepted with no name, one with no locator.

results.title: Production reads live nodes, and a card names a node, never a file
results.expected: The answer's citations are node ids that are live on the asked-about date. A citation that is a filename or a chunk id fails, and so does an answer with no node id.

stimulus.description: A question the live graph covers, with the index also holding a matching chunk.
